mechanisms.description: In The benefits and harms of intravenous thrombolysis with recombinant tissue plasminogen activator within 6 h of acute ischemic stroke (IST-3): a randomised controlled trial, baseline age may modify treatment response through differential baseline cardiovascular risk.
Patients with different age levels may show heterogeneous benefit due to variation in baseline disease burden.
Differences in age may alter event risk trajectories, changing absolute treatment benefit.
The association between age and outcome may interact with treatment intensity in the trial population.
Variation in age may identify subgroups with different competing-risk profiles under treatment.
Trial abstract context suggests age could act as an effect modifier for clinical outcomes.
